evidence.summary: Lincoln publishes an official /60 pre-interview scoring formula with two qualification-stage routes. ApplySmart calculates the official score and applies low-confidence provisional strategic bands because Lincoln has not yet published a first independent-cycle interview threshold.

graduate.notes: Runtime checks the official 2:1 minimum before post-qualification scoring. Degree subject relevance, transcript science coverage and the alternate any-degree plus school-qualification route are recorded as manual-review boundaries because they cannot be safely inferred from free text.

do_not_infer: Do not use estimated interview thresholds as band rules.
Do not apply contextual points to post-qualification or graduate applicants.
Do not use GCSE scoring for achieved A Level, undergraduate or graduate applicants.
Do not treat provisional prediction bands as official current cut-offs.

score_model.basis: Lincoln calculates an official pre-interview selection score out of 60 using the components that apply to this applicant's qualification route.
score_model.label: Total selection score

components.notes: Official Lincoln UCAT cognitive band table. UCAT totals are expected on a 10-point grid; unpublished in-between gap scores are not converted into invented higher bands.

band_explanations.interview_likely: Your Lincoln selection score is in ApplySmart's provisional very strong zone. Lincoln has not published an official interview cutoff for its first independent admissions cycle, so use this as guidance rather than a guaranteed interview.
band_explanations.realistic: Your Lincoln selection score is in ApplySmart's provisional strong zone. Lincoln has not published an official interview cutoff for its first independent admissions cycle, so use this as guidance rather than a guaranteed interview.
band_explanations.ambitious: Your Lincoln selection score is in ApplySmart's provisional realistic zone. Lincoln has not published an official interview cutoff for its first independent admissions cycle, so use this as guidance rather than a guaranteed interview.
band_explanations.high_risk: Your Lincoln selection score is below ApplySmart's provisional competitive zone. Lincoln has not published an official interview cutoff for its first independent admissions cycle, so this does not rule out an interview, but stronger alternatives should be considered.

presentation.selection_summary: Lincoln's official pre-interview score is calculated out of 60, then compared with a provisional competitive benchmark for strategic guidance only.

comparison_guidance.label: Official Lincoln score with provisional strategic benchmark
comparison_guidance.caveat: Lincoln publishes no first-cycle interview threshold. ApplySmart uses Lincoln's published scoring formula plus a provisional 45-50/60 competitive benchmark for strategic guidance only.
